rawContent: @RawStory If trump's appeal to racism was pivotal to his winning then what does that say for the number of white women who voted for trump who are now railing against sexual harassment under the #metoo moniker

@DavidJollyFL @Newyorker2212 And yet, 56+ percent of white women voted for trump. Wonder why? They had enough info to discern that trump's disrespect and disregard for women was on open display before November 2016. He was transparent and spoke with a clear voice. #metoo too late.

@andizeisler @GregMather73 Even under the #metoo movement the constitutional right to due process should be considered. Allegations should be tested. Everyone one isn't being honest and real victims lose if we fail to adhere to some basic standards of judicial redress. #justice even when accused is fair.

@ricknelsonmn1 @andizeisler @GregMather73 Truly understand and agree. I kept silent, at a young age, and found another job when the man I worked for made working for him difficult. He actually asked me not to file sexual harassment against him when I left.  I do believe #metoo is relevant.
